themes.title: Nvidia board probes CEO Huang amid Chinese-spy affair claims
themes.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted in a staff memo to an extramarital affair with a woman US intelligence flagged as a suspected Chinese spy, and the board opened an investigation while President Trump publicly backed Huang keeping his job. The episode drags the world's most consequential AI chipmaker into a national-security and governance crisis at a moment of peak geopolitical sensitivity around AI supply chains.
themes.angle: Board-level and national-security risk at the AI chokepoint — a live case study in exec-governance exposure.

themes.title: Anthropic ships Claude 5.5 family and files S-1
themes.summary: Anthropic released a full Claude 5.5 refresh (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) — Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and costs 40% less than Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5 is 30% faster and up to 30% cheaper — and filed an S-1 for a proposed IPO. Combined signals: it is compressing inference economics while progressing toward a public listing that would test frontier-lab valuations.
themes.angle: Claude 5.5's cost curve plus the S-1 filing may be Anthropic's clearest marker yet that agentic inference is heading down-market fast.

themes.title: GCC acts on AI: ADNOC agents, Saudi compute push
themes.summary: OpenAI is partnering with ADNOC to bring AI agents into oil-and-gas operations, Salesforce reports Agentforce coworker usage growing 21x as Saudi enterprises scale agentic AI into daily work, and Saudi Arabia's communications minister is pitching a 'Partnership for Computing' to widen AI access. Gulf enterprise AI is shifting from ambition to deployed procurement.
themes.angle: GCC enterprise AI is now about deployed agents in energy and operations, not pilots — regional proof-point for the issue.

themes.title: AI power economics tighten: energy buys, siting backlash
themes.summary: Energy is becoming the binding constraint on AI scale. Anthropic bought $3.4bn of gas-fired generation, Digital Realty and Goodman raided a 9.9% stake in Australian data-centre firm NEXTDC, and US voters pushed back on data-centre buildout while the RBA flags AI demand adding near-term inflation pressure. Power, siting and community consent are now board-level AI risks.
themes.angle: The AI investment debate is shifting from 'who builds the model' to 'who can source power and permits'.

themes.title: DeepSeek agent platform hits 1.54M daily users
themes.summary: DeepSeek's AI-agent infrastructure reached 1.54 million daily users, a striking adoption figure from the Chinese open-source stack that keeps pressuring Anthropic and OpenAI on cost and openness. It underscores how open-source agent layers are capturing real, Silicon-Valley-scale usage.
themes.angle: Open-source agents are matching frontier labs on adopted scale — a data point for the inference price war.

themes.title: Agent AI finds flaws in 1,024-bit RSA
themes.summary: Google DeepMind reports its AI agents found two flaws in 1,024-bit RSA, a frontier-security signal that agents are doing real adversarial research. Paired with OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber hacking model, it hints at a security landscape where agents both attack and defend.
themes.angle: Agents are reaching genuine security-research capability — CISOs should be watching this trajectory closely.

themes.title: Apple pushes Siri toward true agentic AI
themes.summary: Apple is exploring turning Siri into a ChatGPT-style agent and pressing for greater AI progress at the executive level, amid a projected iOS 28 shake-up. A late but potentially structural entry into the consumer-agent race.
themes.angle: Apple's agent play could realign the consumer-assistant balance — watch execution, not timing.
